decisive_items: necrosis of vessel walls, and focal fibrinoid necrosis
multiple discrete, round, dry ulcers, most with central eschars
response.rationale: Anti-MPO level is markedly elevated, strongly suggesting ANCA-associated vasculitis; histopathology shows necrotizing vasculitis. GPA is the closest specific candidate, though classic GPA often has PR3-ANCA and systemic features; the skin ulcers and biopsy support a vasculitic process, with Cutaneous Vasculitis as a broader fallback.

rejected.why: ANA and anti-SSA/Ro are weak and nonspecific; no classic lupus features or supportive histology such as interface dermatitis or immune deposits.
Erythema Induratum typically shows lobular panniculitis and tuberculosis association; described pathology is perivascular neutrophilic with vessel necrosis, not fat necrosis.
Less specific descriptor that is encompassed by the ANCA-associated vasculitis pattern; anti-MPO elevation makes R1 more precise.
